tools.name: gf_status
tools.description: Federation SLA/status: build_id, bake time, endpoint health, honest tier.

tools.name: gf_dossier
tools.description: GET entity dossier card (claims[] when ledger-backed).

tools.name: gf_report_feed
tools.description: GET bundled report feed for an entity.

tools.name: gf_cite
tools.description: GET cite catalog, or POST one cite packet {kind,id,claim?}.

tools.name: gf_verify
tools.description: Re-check grounding: source_url + expected must come from published claims[]. Do not invent expected from report HTML. Returns proof_shape.

tools.name: gf_package
tools.description: Package disposition admit/refuse over a published claim object. Returns disposition + versioned proof_shape.

tools.name: gf_darshan
tools.description: GET public Darshan (refuse/admit samples + provenance rail).

tools.name: gf_openapi
tools.description: GET OpenAPI 3 document for federation endpoints.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gf_report_feed, gf_cite, gf_verify · Private data: gf_openapi · Public sink: gf_cite.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gf_report_feed, gf_cite, gf_verify · Private data: gf_openapi · Public sink: gf_cite

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
